title: Purportedly AI-Generated Image Prompted Emergency Investigation of False Fire at South Africa's Orlando West High School
summary: A purportedly AI-generated image reportedly depicting Orlando West High School of Soweto, South Africa, on fire circulated and was allegedly shared with emergency services. Johannesburg EMS reportedly investigated and visited the school, confirming that no fire had occurred. Officials said the false report caused public alarm and diverted emergency resources.
